content:
Total unrestricted permutations: \(\frac{9!}{3!4!2!}=1260\).

Let \(E_a,E_b,E_c\) be the events that all \(a\)'s, all \(b\)'s, all \(c\)'s are adjacent.

\[
|E_a|=\frac{7!}{4!2!}=105,\quad
|E_b|=\frac{6!}{3!2!}=60,\quad
|E_c|=\frac{8!}{3!4!}=280
\]

Pairwise intersections:
\[
|E_a\cap E_b|=\frac{4!}{2!}=12,\quad
|E_a\cap E_c|=\frac{6!}{4!}=30,\quad
|E_b\cap E_c|=\frac{5!}{3!}=20
\]

Triple intersection:
\[
|E_a\cap E_b\cap E_c|=3!=6
\]

By inclusion-exclusion:
\[
|E_a\cup E_b\cup E_c|=105+60+280-(12+30+20)+6=389
\]

Thus valid permutations:
\[
1260-389=871
\]

\[
\boxed{871}
\]
